name: SnomedVitalSignsExtension
title: SNOMED CT Vital Signs Extension
description: A set of codes that are defined in the Vital Signs extension to the SNOMED CT code system. To be used until they are adopted by SNOMED CT.

concept.definition: A device used to measure temperature with digital readout.
A device used to measure temperature via infrared technology that does not come into contact with the skin.
A device used to measure temperature that uses a thermoluminescent diode.
A procedure that uses a computer aided device to measure blood pressure.

concept.display: Measurement of blood pressure using intravascular transducer (procedure)
concept.definition: A device that measures blood pressure intravascularly via a trandsducer.
The subject is wearing clothing but not shoes.
The subject is wearing clothing and shoes.
A device used to measure a subject's height.
A device that captures expelled air, either via nasal prongs or CPAP and is used to measure the number of breaths taken per minute.
A device wrapped around a subject chest that measures the number of times a subject's chest expands with each inhalation.  This counts the breaths per minute.
A device used to lift a patient out of or into bed and also has a scale to measure the subject's weight.

concept.display: Structure of left superficial temporal artery (body structure)
concept.definition: A body structure of the superficial tempral artery on the left side of the body.  Currently part of the Solor SNOMED CT extension.

concept.display: Structure of right superficial temporal artery (body structure)
concept.definition: A body structure of the superficial tempral artery on the right side of the body.  Currently part of the Solor SNOMED CT extension.
